title: LLM Gateway - fallback rate elevated (ticket)

annotations.summary: Dependency health — elevated LLM gateway fallback rate, not a product outage by itself
annotations.threshold: 0.05 (5% fallback share over 30m)
annotations.user_impact: Users may see this Omi capability fail, slow down, or become unavailable.
annotations.scope: The Omi AI chat production service path.
annotations.verification: Verify the condition in the linked Grafana panel and correlate it with production traffic before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the linked dashboard and service readiness; use the documented rollback or capacity path only after verification.

title: Chat response - terminal failure rate elevated

annotations.summary: Chat terminal failures exceed 10% with at least 20 terminal real requests and at least 5 failures in 30m
annotations.threshold: failure share > 0.10; terminal outcomes >= 20; failures >= 5
annotations.user_impact: Users may be unable to complete this Omi interaction or may experience degraded results.
annotations.scope: The Omi AI chat production service path.
annotations.verification: 2026-10-19: a quiet half hour (~22 terminals) with 4 provider_request_rejected 400s on omi:auto:chat-agent drove the 30m success share to 0.81 and set both chat rules pending. The failure floor ($E >= 5) keeps 3-4 rejects in low traffic from paging. Backtest over the full retained history (2026-10-09..10-19, 10m and 5m steps): the old and new conditions both have zero sustained firings; the worst windows are 10-15 16:43Z (success 0.74, 5.1 failures, 20 accepted: still satisfies the new condition) and 10-19 18:13Z (0.81, 4.3 failures: now suppressed). Accepted per 30m is p50 21 / p90 40, so a full outage (~20+ failures per 30m) clears the floor at once.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the linked dashboard and the affected user path; mitigate through the documented service runbook only after verification.

title: Live transcription - attempt failure rate elevated

annotations.summary: Live-transcription failures exceed 10% with at least 20 accepted real attempts in 30m
annotations.threshold: failure share > 0.10; accepted attempts >= 20
annotations.user_impact: Users may not receive live transcript text or may experience degraded results.
annotations.scope: The Omi live-transcription production service path.
annotations.verification: Verify the condition in the linked Grafana panel and correlate it with production traffic before intervention.

title: Capture finalization - durable terminal emission stalled

annotations.summary: At least five durable capture jobs were accepted in 30m with no durable terminal movement
annotations.threshold: accepted movement >= 5; success + failure + stale movement = 0
annotations.user_impact: Capture finalization can be accepted without reaching a customer-visible terminal outcome.
annotations.scope: The durable Firestore capture-finalization projection on backend-listen.
annotations.verification: Confirm the replicated gauge with max across listener pods and inspect nonterminal age before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Use the capture-finalization runbook; do not infer terminal counts from process-local counters or logs.

title: Journey outcomes - scrape source missing

annotations.summary: An expected real-traffic journey metrics scrape target is absent or unhealthy
annotations.threshold: either named scrape job absent or any target up < 1
annotations.user_impact: No confirmed user impact yet; Omi capacity or reliability headroom is reduced.
annotations.scope: The Omi observability production service path.
annotations.verification: Verify the condition in the linked Grafana panel and check service readiness before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect readiness and capacity first; use the documented scaling or rollback path only if the condition persists.

title: LLM Gateway - client reachability degraded

annotations.summary: A backend process opened its LLM gateway circuit after transport failures and is bypassing the gateway
annotations.threshold: max(llm_gateway_circuit_open) > 0 for 5m
annotations.user_impact: Users may be unable to complete this Omi interaction or may experience degraded results.
annotations.scope: Gateway clients in backend-listen and pusher pods (llm_gateway_circuit_open is initialized to 0 there). llm-gateway pods are excluded because they import the gauge but never open a client circuit, so their permanent 0 would mask a client series. If both client jobs stop being scraped, the result is NoData (OK); the backend-listen and pusher scrape/up alerts own that case. The former fallback-share, zero-success and first-byte arms were removed on 2026-10-13: llm_gateway_chat_extraction_requests_total and llm_gateway_client_first_byte_seconds had zero series in prod for 10 days because the main gateway path does not record them.
annotations.verification: Verify the condition in the linked Grafana panel and correlate it with production traffic before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the linked dashboard and the affected user path; mitigate through the documented service runbook only after verification.

title: LLM Gateway - no ready production endpoints

annotations.summary: The production LLM Gateway Service has no ready EndpointSlice address or kube-state-metrics is absent
annotations.threshold: ready endpoint count <1
annotations.user_impact: Users may see this Omi capability fail, slow down, or become unavailable.
annotations.scope: The Omi AI chat production service path.
annotations.verification: Verify the condition in the linked Grafana panel and correlate it with production traffic before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the linked dashboard and service readiness; use the documented rollback or capacity path only after verification.

title: LLM Gateway - clients rejected before routing

annotations.summary: The gateway is rejecting client requests during validation, before a route is selected
annotations.threshold: >= 2 invalid-request rejections in 30m, sustained 30m
annotations.user_impact: Some Omi client population is very likely failing every attempt on this path while other clients look healthy.
annotations.scope: The Omi LLM gateway request-validation path, ahead of provider routing.
annotations.verification: Confirm the rejection count in the linked panel, then split production request logs by client user agent to identify which client population is affected.
annotations.safe_next_action: Identify the rejected parameter and the client that sends it, then follow the documented gateway kill-switch runbook before changing gateway configuration.

title: LLM Gateway - lane failing a large share of real requests

model.expr: (sum by (lane_id) (increase(llm_gateway_requests_total{outcome!="success"}[1h])) - (sum by (lane_id) (increase(llm_gateway_requests_total{outcome!="success",lane_id="omi:auto:proactive-notification",error_class="invalid_request",provider="none"}[1h])) or sum by (lane_id) (increase(llm_gateway_requests_total{outcome!="success"}[1h])) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (lane_id) (increase(llm_gateway_requests_total[1h])), 1)

annotations.summary: One gateway lane is failing more than a quarter of its real requests over an hour
annotations.threshold: failure share > 0.25 with >= 20 real requests in 1h, per lane. Excludes omi:auto:proactive-notification pre-provider invalid_request refusals (error_class=invalid_request, provider=none: proactivity_admission.call_limit per-user/per-item caps, no provider call, no cost; ~47/h on 2026-10-19).
annotations.user_impact: The Omi capability served by this lane may be unavailable or degraded for the users who reach it.
annotations.scope: A single production LLM gateway lane; other lanes are evaluated independently.
annotations.verification: Confirm the failing lane and its provider rejection class in the linked panel before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the lane route configuration and provider status on the linked dashboard, then follow the documented gateway runbook.

title: LLM Gateway - lane has served no successful request

annotations.summary: A gateway lane has made at least 20 real attempts in six hours and completed none of them
annotations.threshold: successful requests < 1 with >= 20 real attempts in 6h, per lane
annotations.user_impact: The Omi capability served by this lane is very likely completely unavailable to every user who reaches it.
annotations.scope: A single production LLM gateway lane; other lanes are evaluated independently.
annotations.verification: Confirm in the linked panel that the lane has attempts but no successful outcome, and read its provider rejection class.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the lane route configuration and provider credentials on the linked dashboard, then follow the documented gateway runbook.

title: Journey outcomes - a journey stopped reporting while the platform serves traffic

model.expr: (sum by (journey) (increase(omi_journey_accepted_total{journey=~"pusher_session|capture_finalization"}[1h])) < bool 1) * on() group_left() (sum(increase(llm_gateway_requests_total[1h])) > bool 100) or (sum by (journey) (increase(omi_journey_accepted_total{journey="chat_response"}[1h])) < bool 1) * on() group_left() (sum(increase(llm_gateway_requests_total{lane_id="omi:auto:chat-agent"}[1h])) > bool 20)

annotations.summary: A journey that normally reports every hour has reported nothing while the platform is demonstrably serving traffic
annotations.threshold: 0 accepted attempts for a journey in 1h while gateway requests exceed 100 in the same hour
annotations.user_impact: Users may already be affected on this path with no other alert able to fire, because the evidence this journey's alerts depend on is missing.
annotations.scope: The real-traffic journey counters that the Omi resilience alerts are built on.
annotations.verification: Check whether the emitting service is still scraped and still running before assuming the user path itself is healthy.
annotations.safe_next_action: Restore the metrics path for the affected service first; do not treat a missing journey signal as evidence that the user path is working.

title: Capture finalization - canonical memory admission failure

annotations.summary: A real capture finalization was rejected by the canonical-memory runtime admission fence
annotations.threshold: at least one memory_fence or memory_config finalization failure in 5m
annotations.user_impact: At least one accepted voice capture could not complete finalization because its serving runtime could not safely mutate canonical memory.
annotations.scope: Persisted conversation finalization on Pusher and Cloud Tasks workers.
annotations.verification: Confirm the bounded reason and exact serving image/config receipt; do not infer the cause from HTTP status or workflow state alone.
annotations.safe_next_action: Halt promotion, preserve the durable retry queue, and restore a capability-admitted image plus config bundle before replay.

title: Capture finalization - success rate below paging floor

annotations.summary: Capture finalization success share below the 90% paging floor while at least 20 journeys were accepted in 30m
annotations.threshold: accepted >= 20 per 30m and success / (success + failure) < 0.90
annotations.user_impact: Voice recordings are accepted but not becoming conversations; users lose captures entirely.
annotations.scope: The capture-finalization journey outcome on backend-listen.
annotations.verification: Confirm the success tile and the accepted-vs-settled panel on the linked Core Features dashboard before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Follow the real-traffic journeys runbook; treat a low success share with real accepted traffic as a user-facing outage, not a capacity signal.

title: Pusher session - success rate below paging floor

annotations.summary: Pusher session success share below the 90% paging floor while at least 20 journeys were accepted in 30m
annotations.threshold: accepted >= 20 per 30m and success / (success + failure) < 0.90
annotations.user_impact: Live sessions are ending in failure; users lose realtime transcription sessions.
annotations.scope: The pusher-session journey outcome on backend-listen.
annotations.verification: Confirm the success tile and the accepted-vs-settled panel on the linked Core Features dashboard before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Follow the real-traffic journeys runbook; treat a low success share with real accepted traffic as a user-facing outage, not a capacity signal.

annotations.threshold: accepted >= 20 per 30m and success / (success + failure) < 0.90 and failures >= 5 per 30m
annotations.user_impact: Chat requests are terminalizing as failures; users cannot get AI chat responses.
annotations.scope: The chat-response journey outcome on the Cloud Run backend, ingested via the cloud-run-application-metrics bridge.

The failure floor ($E >= 5) keeps 3-4 rejects in low traffic from paging. Backtest over the full retained history (2026-10-09..10-19, 10m and 5m steps): the old and new conditions both have zero sustained firings; the worst windows are 10-15 16:43Z (success 0.74, 5.1 failures, 20 accepted: still satisfies the new condition) and 10-19 18:13Z (0.81, 4.3 failures: now suppressed). Accepted per 30m is p50 21 / p90 40, so a full outage (~20+ failures per 30m) clears the floor at once.
annotations.safe_next_action: Follow the real-traffic journeys runbook; treat a low success share with real accepted traffic as a user-facing outage, not a capacity signal.

title: Capture finalization - accepted work is not settling

annotations.summary: At least 100 capture journeys were accepted in 1h while more than 50 of them per hour never reached any terminal outcome
annotations.threshold: accepted >= 100 per 1h and accepted - settled > 50 per 1h
annotations.user_impact: Captures are queueing without outcomes; the finalization backlog grows and users do not get their conversations.
annotations.scope: The capture-finalization accept and terminal counters on backend-listen.
annotations.verification: Confirm the accepted-vs-settled gap and the oldest unfinished job on the linked Core Features dashboard before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Follow the real-traffic journeys runbook; inspect finalization worker health and the Firestore job queue before any pod restarts.

title: Capture finalization - oldest unfinished job too old

annotations.summary: The oldest unfinished capture finalization job has been waiting longer than 1 hour
annotations.threshold: max oldest nonterminal age > 3600s for 15m
annotations.user_impact: At least one user capture has been stuck for over an hour; sustained backlogs mean many users are missing conversations.
annotations.scope: The finalization job queue age gauge republished by backend-listen.
annotations.verification: Confirm the oldest unfinished job tile and the unfinished-jobs panel on the linked Core Features dashboard before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Follow the real-traffic journeys runbook; the gauge aggregates with max across listener pods, so verify one pod is not reporting a stale value.

title: Capture finalization - summary has never published

annotations.summary: Capture finalization - summary has not published
annotations.threshold: Warning when no successful summary timestamp has been scraped for 30m and that absence persists for another 30m. This is not a page.
annotations.user_impact: Summary freshness has not yet been established; this can be expected before the backend-listen image ships or during prolonged restarts and lease handoffs.
annotations.scope: No backend-listen pod has published the summary timestamp within the last 30m.
annotations.verification: Check backend-listen rollout and lease state first, then inspect Firestore summary query logs and the metric scrape.
annotations.safe_next_action: Confirm the backend-listen image is deployed; if it is, investigate why the Firestore summary has not published.

title: Capture finalization - Firestore summary stale

annotations.summary: Capture finalization - Firestore summary stale
annotations.threshold: Critical only after a previously published Firestore summary timestamp is older than 900s for 5m; the 30m query window must still contain a sample.
annotations.user_impact: The oldest unfinished capture age may be stale because no listen pod has completed a Firestore summary recently.
annotations.scope: Maximum last-success timestamp across backend-listen pods; missing series is OK for this critical rule until a summary has been published.
annotations.verification: Check the summary freshness metric and backend-listen Firestore query logs; a missing series is handled by the separate warning.
annotations.safe_next_action: Restore summary reads and verify a successful Firestore summary republishes the age and status gauges.

title: Capture finalization - dead-letter surge

annotations.summary: More than 50 capture finalization jobs were terminalized as dead letters in 1h
annotations.threshold: increase over 1h > 50
annotations.user_impact: Each dead letter is a user capture that failed every retry and will never become a conversation.
annotations.scope: The finalization dead-letter counter on backend-listen.
annotations.verification: Confirm the dead-letter tile and the retries panel on the linked Core Features dashboard before intervention.
annotations.safe_next_action: Follow the real-traffic journeys runbook; dead letters after a backlog often point at the finalization worker, not the listener.

title: Durable queue - oldest ready item stalled

annotations.summary: A durable queue has a ready item older than 6 hours, or an age sample is absent or unknown
annotations.threshold: oldest ready age > 6h, absent(), or unknown sample for 5m
annotations.user_impact: Independent items behind a poison head can stall: memories, task integrations, Chat-first cards, or capture finalization may stop advancing.
annotations.scope: Every backend durable queue that publishes omi_queue_oldest_ready_age_seconds.
annotations.verification: Break down omi_queue_oldest_ready_age_seconds and omi_queue_oldest_ready_sample_unknown by queue; check the sampler read cap and metadata failures, then inspect that queue's dead-letter rows and last_error_text before changing retry budgets.
annotations.safe_next_action: Confirm poison items reached a dead letter; redrive by identity only after the error is understood. Do not raise the attempt budget.

title: Live STT - provider chain exhaustion standing degradation

annotations.summary: More than 35% of accepted /v4/listen sessions exhaust the live-STT provider chain in 5m
annotations.threshold: exhausted / listen-accepted > 0.35 with >= 50 accepted sockets in 5m, for 10m
annotations.user_impact: Live transcription is failing for a large minority of sessions; clients reconnect and audio falls to offline sync. This is the standing 16-25% degradation becoming worse, not yet the 2026-09-19 outage.
annotations.scope: backend-listen live STT selection (omi_fallback_total component=stt_selection outcome=exhausted over omi_listen_accepted_total).
annotations.verification: Evidence layer is Cloud Logging counts of omi_fallback_event component=stt_selection outcome=exhausted on backend-listen (job=backend-listen-metrics Counter, not a Stackdriver gauge — increase() is the correct function) divided by measured /v4/listen accepts in the same 2-minute fleet samples. 2026-09-18 09:00Z (tolerable): 57 exhausted / 227 accepts = 0.251. 2026-09-19 04:40Z (incident): 562 / 688 = 0.817. 2026-09-19 09:30Z (incident): 811 / 913 = 0.888. 2026-09-20 14:30Z (recovered): 57 / 347 = 0.164. 5m exhausted counts: tolerable 135, recovered 163, incident 1376. Prometheus evaluation of this exact increase() expression is still owed by whoever can query prod Prometheus/Grafana read-only; this agent used the log counts of the same events.
annotations.safe_next_action: Confirm the ratio on Resilience / Fallbacks panel 15, then inspect which to_mode is exhausting (panel 16) before changing provider credentials or capacity.

title: Live STT - provider chain exhaustion outage

annotations.summary: More than 60% of accepted /v4/listen sessions exhaust the live-STT provider chain in 5m
annotations.threshold: exhausted / listen-accepted > 0.60 with >= 50 accepted sockets in 5m, for 5m
annotations.user_impact: Most live sessions die in initialize_stt(); clients reconnect every ~35s and conversations fragment. This is the 2026-09-19 04:40Z failure class (82-89%), separated from the 16-25% standing baseline.
annotations.scope: backend-listen live STT selection (omi_fallback_total component=stt_selection outcome=exhausted over omi_listen_accepted_total).
annotations.verification: Evidence layer is Cloud Logging counts of omi_fallback_event component=stt_selection outcome=exhausted on backend-listen (job=backend-listen-metrics Counter, not a Stackdriver gauge — increase() is the correct function) divided by measured /v4/listen accepts in the same 2-minute fleet samples. 2026-09-18 09:00Z (tolerable): 57 exhausted / 227 accepts = 0.251. 2026-09-19 04:40Z (incident): 562 / 688 = 0.817. 2026-09-19 09:30Z (incident): 811 / 913 = 0.888. 2026-09-20 14:30Z (recovered): 57 / 347 = 0.164. 5m exhausted counts: tolerable 135, recovered 163, incident 1376. Prometheus evaluation of this exact increase() expression is still owed by whoever can query prod Prometheus/Grafana read-only; this agent used the log counts of the same events.
annotations.safe_next_action: Confirm panel 15 is above 0.60, then check Deepgram/Parakeet fallback-leg health on panel 16 and the live-STT failure-ratio panel before rolling credentials or disabling a provider.

title: Redis cache - connection-class write failures

annotations.summary: Listen or pusher is skipping Redis cache writes because of auth, connection, or timeout errors.
annotations.threshold: cache-write fail-open increase over 10m > 0, sustained for 10m
annotations.user_impact: Requests can keep succeeding while best-effort Redis writes are skipped. If this continues, in-progress conversation pointers and meeting mappings go stale, and a credential drift can grow into listen-session failures.
annotations.scope: omi_fallback_total component=other from_mode=cache_write reason=auth_error|connection_error|timeout outcome=degraded on jobs backend-listen-metrics and pusher-metrics. capacity_full is excluded.
annotations.verification: Run this alert expression and split the increase by reason and job. Confirm Redis reachability and that the listen and pusher Redis password still matches Redis Cloud. Do not read customer payloads.
annotations.safe_next_action: For auth_error, update the Redis password secret and roll only the affected deployment after the new secret is confirmed. For connection_error or timeout, check Redis Cloud status and pod connectivity before changing credentials.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Not measured in Prometheus. The 2026-10-08 dev incident raised AuthenticationError before this counter existed and failed every listen accept. That shape is about one cache_write fail-open per accept.
annotations.evaluated_good: Healthy Redis auth emits none of these reasons, so the 10m increase is 0.

title: Redis cache - connection-class write failures degrading sessions

annotations.summary: Redis auth, connection, or timeout errors are skipping cache writes on a large share of accepted listen sessions.
annotations.threshold: fail-open count / listen accepts > 0.5 with at least 50 accepts in 5m, for 5m
annotations.user_impact: In-progress conversation pointers and meeting mappings are missing on many live sessions. Before this fail-open, the same Redis auth errors returned 500 on listen accept.
annotations.scope: omi_fallback_total component=other from_mode=cache_write reason=auth_error|connection_error|timeout outcome=degraded on jobs backend-listen-metrics and pusher-metrics, divided by omi_listen_accepted_total on backend-listen-metrics. capacity_full is excluded.
annotations.verification: Confirm the 5m ratio on this expression, then split by reason and job. A ratio near 1 with auth_error is a credential drift, not a capacity event.
annotations.safe_next_action: Verify the failing job and reason, then restore Redis auth or connectivity for that deployment. Do not widen maxmemory or mute the warning while the ratio stays above 0.5.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Not measured in Prometheus. The 2026-10-08 dev incident failed every listen accept on AuthenticationError, which this ratio treats as about 1.0.
annotations.evaluated_good: Healthy Redis auth emits none of these reasons, so the ratio is 0 even when listen accepts are above 50.

title: Reason enums - unknown reason ratio elevated

model.expr: (sum by (family) (rate(omi_reason_unknown_total[30m])) / clamp_min(sum by (family) (rate(omi_reason_total[30m])), 1e-9)) and on (family) (sum by (family) (increase(omi_reason_total[30m])) > 50)

annotations.summary: A reason family has an unknown share above 2% with enough events to evaluate.
annotations.user_impact: A known reason mapped to unknown can misroute retries or provider fallback. The Parakeet cancelled-to-connection_lost mislabel caused about $75/day of false Soniox routing for five days.
annotations.scope: Evaluated per family: unknown reason rate divided by total reason rate over 30m, with a same-window total-volume guard.
annotations.verification: Inspect the family and emitting site; compare unknown and total reason rates with the reason mapping and route outcomes.
annotations.safe_next_action: Find the emitting site that maps a known reason to unknown; verify its enum mapping before changing provider routing.
annotations.threshold: Unknown share >2% and more than 50 total reason events in the rolling 30m window; the condition must persist for 30m.
annotations.incident: Parakeet cancelled-to-connection_lost mislabel: about $75/day of false Soniox routing for five days. See backend/docs/runbooks/live-stt-routing.md for the reason contract.
